source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of function call management (PDF 99).

blocks.text: Programming mein function calls sambhalne ke liye stacks bohat kaam aate hain. Ek saada misal: sochiye aap ek ke baad ek phone calls kar rahe hain. Har call par aap us shakhs ka naam notepad par likhte hain, aur baat khatam hone par naam kaat dete hain.

items: Call karna: call karte waqt aap naam notepad par sab se oopar likhte hain. Yeh stack par maloomat push karne jaisa hai.
Call khatam karna: baat khatam hone par naam kaat dete hain. Yeh stack se maloomat pop karne jaisa hai.

blocks.text: Programming mein jab koi function call hota hai to us ki tafseel (use kya karna hai aur kaam ke baad kahan wapas jana hai) stack par likh di jati hai. Is se computer ko yaad rehta hai ke aage kya karna hai. Function khatam hone par us ki tafseel stack se pop ho jati hai, bilkul naam kaatne ki tarah.

blocks.prompt: Agar main() function f() ko call kare aur f() function g() ko, to yeh kis tarteeb mein khatam honge?
blocks.explanation: Pehle g(), phir f(), phir main(). Jo call aakhir mein hui woh pehle khatam hoti hai (LIFO).

items: Har function call stack par push hoti hai aur function khatam hone par pop.
